editorial.description_en: Sea under cloud: the same water as between-waves with the light taken out of it, which lowers the chroma before it lowers the lightness.
editorial.description_ja: 曇りの日の海のような、しずんだ青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.646, C 0.052, h 240.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 曇り (kumori, cloudiness) + 波 (nami, wave). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Clouded Wave" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 曇波. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — fuyu-umi at ΔE00 6.6, nami-ma at ΔE00 6.7, yu-mizu at ΔE00 6.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (60°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
